title: 2023 occupation-method AEWR rule for non-field SOCs: pre-rule employer x worksite-state units, share-weighted log-floor dose, receipt FY2020-FY2025, with the 2023-2025 updates, the Teche injunction and the vacatur weeks
proposer: catalogue (plan A3); power-triage P1 (FY2026 reversal) merged in at triage
implementer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Phase 2 acquisition and Phase 3 A3 designer)
kill_reason: Design-stage size-valid MDE exceeds 1.0 under every DGP. Gate DGP (node-period share 0.0094 vs 0.0043 pure unit noise, ratio 2.17 > 1.5) = largest shared DGP: under shared_region_serial no inference method passes the size gate (state CRV1 null 0.086, upper 0.105; state jackknife 0.064, upper 0.081; node CRV1 upper 0.103), so the gate MDE is undefined; the size-valid shared MDEs are 5.52 (shared_region_and_pair, state CRV1) and 9.22 (spatial) in epsilon_cost at pi = 1, i.e. 6.9 and 11.5 at the declared pi_design = 0.8. Even under pure unit noise the size-valid MDE is 2.05 at pi = 1 (2.56 at pi = 0.8). The occupation-group controls needed against the pre-rule non-field growth trend leave a dose SD of 0.0071 log points after FE across 12.4 effective states. Not pooling-eligible. No outcome contrast was computed.
estimand: PPML elasticity eta of employer x worksite-state certified H-2A contract hours with respect to the unit's pre-rule-share-weighted log statutory floor (non-field occupation rates of the 2023 rule relative to the state field floor), unit FE + state x FY FE + occupation-group share x FY controls; epsilon_cost = (eta / pi_hat) x ratio_A3.
primary_outcome: cert_hours (shared case rows, receipt FY window rfy, FY2020-FY2025), unit = employer_id_balanced x worksite state, PPML
dose: x_ut = sum over u's FY2020-FY2022 job cells c of s_c x receipt-day-weighted log floor: field cells log F_s(d) = log max(FLS AEWR in force [Kansas-group dates], state ag minimum); non-field cells log N_sg(d) = log F before 2023-03-30, log max(OEWS statewide mean of the vintage in force [May 2021/2022/2023/2024; Kansas-group 2025-07-25], F) from 2023-03-30 (31-day linear ramp) to 2025-08-28, log F from 2025-08-29 (vacatur) and for the Louisiana sugar cane Teche proxy from 2024-09-20. Weights omega_d = national FY2020-22 rfy hours by receipt month. Log points. PPML-weighted non-field gap 0.090 (FY2023), 0.296 (FY2024), 0.266 (FY2025).
identifying_assumption: Within a state and conditional on national occupation-group trends scaled by each unit's pre-rule exposure, units whose pre-rule non-field occupations received larger 2023-rule floor increases relative to the state field floor would have had the same proportional growth in certified hours as other units.

conversion.formula: epsilon_cost = (eta / pi_hat) x ratio_A3; ITT eta x ratio_A3; epsilon_w = eta / pi_hat (dose in log floor, so d ln C = (w/C) d ln w)

cost_ratio_used.rule: FY2020-FY2025 certified-hours-weighted cost_unit_by_fy.csv ratios (cost_unit_summary.csv); SD1 FY2020-FY2026 recomputed (FY2026 central_vs_h2a_cash); non-field-floor ratio as sensitivity S8b

conversion.assumptions: dC = dw; offered wage = H-2A wage (FY2020-FY2025); floor priced at filing, receipt date proxies job-order date (31-day ramp); pre-rule job mix fixes exposure; litigated rule (possibly expected temporary). pi not estimated (killed before estimation); pi_design 0.8 from the predetermined pre-rule-offer bound 0.907 (FY2022 offers, max(premium, gap)) times about 0.95 at-or-above-rate compliance seen in acquisition, rounded down for within-unit relabeling.

support.basis: 83,301 employer x worksite-state units x 6 receipt FY (FY2020-FY2025), PPML weights = FY2020-22 mean rfy hours; dose in log points after unit + state x FY FE and the occupation-group share x FY controls (FWL), weighted; 167 nodes (state x unit type), effective nodes 24.8, max node leverage 0.113 (LA heavy truck drivers, which carry the Teche proxy); residual SD of the PPML-linearized FY2020-22 outcome after FE.
support.treated_cells: 6,654 pre-rule non-field cells (employer x state x SOC) in 45 states and 282 state x SOC shock cells with 20.57 million FY2020-22 hours (2.19% of pre-rule hours); 6,250 cells / 246 shock cells / 18.48 million hours (1.97%) with a positive 2024 gap; 404 zero-gap cells / 36 shock cells / 2.09 million hours (placebo group). 6,303 units have non-field hours, 3,993 are non-field-majority. Largest SOCs by pre hours: 47-2061 8.82M, 53-3032 5.16M, 45-1011 1.83M, 49-3041 0.59M.
support.other_candidates: dose SD / effective states: no controls 0.0156 / 13.3; non-field share control 0.0089 / 12.1; drop FY2023 0.0077 / 12.5; statutory floor 0.0075 / 11.0; no ramp 0.0071 / 12.4; no Teche 0.0064 / 12.4; SD1 rq13d FY2020-26 0.0076 / 15.8 (67,292 units); requested positions 0.0071 / 12.1; employer x FY FE 0.0054 / 10.0 (2,170 units); SD2 cells state x FY 0.0217 / 9.1; cells employer x FY 0.0444 / 6.3. The occupation controls remove 79% of the dose variance. File $S/A3/a3_support.csv.

design_mde_by_dgp.note: epsilon_cost at pi_design = 0.8, central ratio; pi = 1 values: county_serial 2.05 (state CRV1), shared_region_and_pair 5.52 (state CRV1), spatial 9.22 (state CRV1), shared_region_serial no size-valid method (non-size-valid MDEs 5.69-6.13). The gate MDE (largest shared DGP) is undefined because shared_region_serial has no size-valid method; every defined value exceeds 1.0. Secondary runs at pi = 1: SD1 rq13d FY2020-26 county 1.95, pair 4.80, spatial 7.72, shared_region none; requested positions county 2.05 (state CV3J), pair 5.95, spatial 9.90; no-controls (S1), non-field-share control (S2) and relabeling-exposed cells (SD2) have no size-valid method under any DGP (null rejection up to 0.47-0.62 under shared DGPs without occupation controls: occupation-level shocks load on the dose). Files $S/A3/a3_power_{support,calibration,mde,null,summary}.csv.

gate_dgp: max over shared DGPs: ish_node_period_share on the PPML-linearized FY2020-22 hours with node = state x unit type gives 0.00939 vs 0.00433 pure unit noise (ratio 2.17 > 1.5)
inference_primary: none size-valid under the gate DGP (shared_region_serial); state_fips_CRV1 is size-valid under county_serial, shared_region_and_pair_serial and spatial_region_serial
split_detail: No data-driven tuning: units, cells, dose, ramp, Teche proxy, controls, FE, weights and inference fixed in the registry; the employer x worksite-state total-hours outcome is invariant to SOC relabeling, so no task classifier was needed. 45 states with dose and 282 shock cells would permit a split.
prior_exposure: Power triage: national share of certified positions in non-field SOCs FY2014-FY2026 Q1-Q3 (post-period tabulation of the treated group) and proxy-rate harness runs on FY2020-22 residual variance. Credibility triage: FY2018-25 certified positions by field vs non-field SOC. Acquisition: non-field offered hourly wages FY2022-FY2026 matched to the acquired rates by receipt period (70.8% exact in the rule window, none before 2023-03-30, 65% at FLS in the vacatur window, Louisiana 53-3032 around Teche). markdowns/aewr_2023_rule_change_design.md (design only). alternative_identification_exploration.md section 3 (Track 1 FY2026 county outcomes) and sections 1-2; A1 FY2025-vs-FY2026 estimates (not read by this designer) overlap SD1 only. This designer printed national rq13d certified hours by receipt FY2020-FY2026 (all occupations, not by dose) while checking coverage, and read FY2020-22 unit outcomes only for weights and residual variance, FY2020-22 non-field hours by SOC, and FY2022 non-field offers for the pass-through bound.
falsification_result: not_run (killed at design); declared F1 pre-trend leads (FY2020-21 vs FY2022), F2 placebo cutoff 2021-03-30 (gating); F3 zero-gap placebo group, F4 filing timing around 2023-03-30, F5 balance, F6 vacatur sign check (reported)
pooling_exclusion_reason: design-stage size-valid MDE > 1.0 (killed at Phase 3); also external-validity flagged (sensitivity pool only)
external_validity_flag: true: non-field occupations (construction laborers, heavy truck drivers, supervisors, mechanics; 2.19% of pre-rule hours) with distinct domestic outside options; the same different-occupation criterion the declarations apply to A4. Would enter only the sensitivity pool.
notes: Scripts A3/02_units_dose.R, 03_support.R, 04_power.R (this ledger row was written by hand from the 04_power outputs; no 05 script was needed). Outputs and logs in $S/A3/. Design facts for A6 or later work: (1) the 2025-10-02 IFR is not an opposite-signed event for non-field jobs in log terms (PPML-weighted non-field gap over the field floor 0.284 in FY2025 vs 0.260 in FY2026 Q1-Q3, rq13d), because the field floor fell proportionally; the only true reversal is the 2025-08-29 to 2025-10-01 vacatur window, 5 weeks of FY2025 Q4. (2) Without occupation-group controls the design fails the size gate under every DGP, including pure unit noise, so the triage's 0.56 (proxy rates, cells, no controls) does not survive the exact rates and the harness. (3) The Teche proxy (534 Louisiana cane/sugar units, 585,179 pre-rule non-field hours) carries the largest node leverage.
